statement: The proportion of SUID cases with maternal mental health issues prior to pregnancy is compared to the weighted prevalence of such issues in a population reference.
rationale: This study aims to compare the presence of pre-pregnancy mental health issues among SUID cases (from case series) and their prevalence in a general population sample (population reference).
prior_art: None in the inputs. Previous research has not extensively examined how maternal pre-pregnancy psychological state affects SUID risk, despite significant potential impact on infant care and development.
required_concepts: Maternal mental health issues prior to pregnancy
cannot_establish: Causation, incidence rates without a full denominator source.
